brief:
An independent inquiry into British involvement in alleged Israeli genocide in Gaza convened nearly a year ago under the leadership of former Labour MP Jeremy Corbyn, scholar Neve Gordon, and Palestinian activist Shahd Hammouri. The Gaza Tribunal, a nongovernmental tribunal held in London, examined the United Kingdom's role and responsibility in the conflict, Democracy Now! reported.

The three co-chairs discussed their tribunal's findings on alleged UK complicity in the Gaza situation during an appearance with the outlet. The independent inquiry operated outside official government structures to investigate Britain's involvement in events in Palestinian territories, drawing on testimony and evidence presented over the course of the proceedings held in the British capital.

title: Corbyn, Gordon, Hammouri detail UK complicity findings in Gaza tribunal
